newsitem.title: USA: International Lottery CFO Hainke resigns.
newsitem.headline: International Lottery CFO Hainke resigns.

text.p: International Lottery & Totalizator Systems Inc said Monday William Hainke resigned as chief financial officer and treasurer, effective May 1 to pursue other business opportunities.
Dennis Klahn, the company's controller, was named as the acting chief financial officer.

Separately, International Lottery said it received an order valued at over $4 million from Leisure Management Berhad of Malaysia for the supply of lottery terminals and related software for its Magnum Lottery.
